findings.admission: This read-only corpus does not update Windows Rule coverage, the 883 ledger or enabled capabilities.
findings.comparison_reader_gaps: Eight Registry comparisons retain original HKEY_* State operands in the source reader versus native enum operands; three WMI57 comparisons retain source wql field versus native query. Sorting conjunctions by differing terms also changes first-divergence paths. These remain term mismatches, not admitted equivalence or established executable-semantic defects. Full original/native terms are retained.
findings.identifier_failure: One appcmd Variable has a punctuation-only source comment, producing an empty native identifier stem; current schema rejects it. No emitted file or admission is accepted.
findings.unsupported_proof: Six nil-selector cases are compiled but not proved by the current independent reader.
